labors of hercules.flag: closed set: exactly the twelve labors; the last four use their usual multi-word titles (mares of Diomedes, girdle of Hippolyta, cattle of Geryon, apples of the Hesperides)

turkish folklore.flag: about 30 members; most are specialist (familiarity 4-5); names written without Turkish diacritics (Keloglan, Karagoz, Sahmeran)

revolutions.flag: written as the qualifier only (Velvet, Glorious, Cuban) so the word does not give away the theme; many qualifiers are also ordinary words, so check collisions with other themes

dynasties.flag: non-Chinese, non-European ruling dynasties written as the dynasty name (Abbasid, Joseon, Tokugawa); European royal houses go to royal houses, empire names to empires

empires.flag: written as the qualifier only (Ottoman, Mongol, Aztec), like the revolutions theme
